summary: The Kassites from the Zagros took control of Babylon and ruled it for nearly four centuries, the longest dynasty in its history.
summary_zh: 来自扎格罗斯山区的加喜特人控制巴比伦，统治近四个世纪，是巴比伦历史上最长的王朝。
n: Wikipedia dates Kassite rule c. 1531 to c. 1155 BC, under four centuries, not over.
n_zh: 据维基百科，加喜特人统治约在前1531年至前1155年，不足四个世纪。

n: Wikipedia says Zu Yi moved the capital from Xiang to Geng, then to Bi, not Xing.
n_zh: 维基百科称祖乙先由相迁都于耿，后迁于庇，未提邢。

n: Chinese Wikipedia says the Ugaritic alphabet has 31 letters, not 30.
n_zh: 中文维基百科称乌加里特字母表含31个字母，而非30个。

n: Wikipedia says the Mao Gong ding inscription has 500 characters (32 lines), not 497.
n_zh: 维基百科称毛公鼎铭文为500字（32行），而非497字。

n: Wikipedia gives four theories for when Chu moved to Ying; only one dates it to 689 BC under King Wen.
n_zh: 维基百科称楚迁都于郢有四种说法，仅其一认为是前689年楚文王时。

summary: A road of about 2,700 km with relay stations linked Susa to Sardis, so royal couriers could cross the empire in about nine days.
summary_zh: 一条长约2700公里、设有驿站的大道连接苏萨与萨第斯，王室信使约九天即可横穿帝国。
n: Per Wikipedia, mounted couriers covered the road in nine days, not a week.
n_zh: 据维基百科，骑马信使走完御道需九天，而非一周。

n: English Wikipedia says five months; the Shiji counts six (陈胜王凡六月).
n_zh: 英文维基百科作五个月；《史记》作“陈胜王凡六月”。

n: Wikipedia gives Chen Xi death as November or December 196 BC, not 195 BCE.
n_zh: 维基百科记载陈豨卒于前196年，而非前195年。

n: English Wikipedia says Liu Che ascended at age 15; Chinese Wikipedia says 16 (East Asian age counting).
n_zh: 英文维基百科称刘彻即位时15岁，中文维基百科称十六岁登基。

n: Wikipedia dates Geumgwan Gaya to 43-532, not AD 42 (legendary founding).
n_zh: 维基百科称金官伽倻存续于43至532年，而非公元42年（传说建国年）。

summary: Three Han armies of 30,000 cavalry struck at Tanshihuai's Xianbei confederation and were routed, losing seventy to eighty percent of their men.
summary_zh: 夏育、田晏、臧旻三路出击檀石槐，大败而还，十丧七八。
n: Han losses were seven to eight in ten (70-80%), not nearly 90 percent, per Chinese Wikipedia.
n_zh: 据中文维基百科，汉军死者十之七八，而非近九成。

summary: Han Zhao besieges Chang'an until Emperor Min surrenders. He is killed two years later.
summary_zh: 汉赵军围困长安，晋愍帝出城投降，两年后遇害。
n: Emperor Min surrendered in 316 and was executed in 318, two years later, per Wikipedia.
n_zh: 据维基百科，晋愍帝316年投降，318年被杀，即两年后。

n: Chinese Wikipedia says Crown Prince Geunsugu led 30,000 troops to take Pyongyang and kill Gogugwon in 371, not Geunchogo himself.
n_zh: 中文维基称371年率3万军攻取平壤、处死故国原王者为太子近仇首王，而非近肖古王本人。

n: Wikipedia says Emperor Wu is criticized for a lavish lifestyle, though generally able and diligent.
n_zh: 据维基百科，齐武帝被批评生活奢华，但总体被认为勤勉能干。

n: Wikipedia says Mazdak was killed by Khusrau I (r. 531-579), with Kavad I's reign 498-531; no 528 suppression stated.
n_zh: 据维基百科，玛兹达克被库思老一世（531-579年在位）所杀，未提及528年被镇压。

n: Wikipedia dates give birth 13 Oct 467 and death 26 Apr 499 (age 31); the summaries give 32 and 33.
n_zh: 据维基百科，孝文帝生于467年10月13日、卒于499年4月26日（31岁）；中英文简介分别写作32岁和33岁。

n: Wikipedia says the Yupian has 12,158 entries (Feng Yan claimed 16,917), not clearly over 16,000.
n_zh: 维基百科称《玉篇》收字12158个（封演称16917字），并非明确超过一万六千。

n: Wikipedia labels the 614 campaign the fourth invasion (the 613 one being the third), and Goguryeo returned Hu Sizheng.
n_zh: 维基百科称614年这次为第四次征伐（613年为第三次），高句丽遣还斛斯政。

n: Wikipedia's opening dates the struggle to 785–816; other accounts stretch it over the 8th–10th centuries.
n_zh: 维基百科开篇将三方之争定于785—816年；也有说法认为延续八至十世纪。

n: Chinese Wikipedia says Feng Dao served five dynasties, eight surnames and eleven emperors.
n_zh: 中文维基百科称冯道历事五朝、八姓、十一帝。

n: English Wikipedia says Chai Rong left a six-year-old heir; Chinese Wikipedia says seven.
n_zh: 英文维基百科称其继承人六岁，中文维基百科称七岁。

n: Wikipedia says Hugh Capet's dynasty ruled France for nearly nine centuries (987 to 1848 via cadet branches).
n_zh: 维基百科称其王朝统治法国近九个世纪（987年至1848年，含旁支）。

n: Chinese Wikipedia gives the vimana height as 61 metres, not 66.
n_zh: 中文维基百科称其塔高61米。

n: Wikipedia gives earlier estimates of about 20,000, but a recent study says the population did not exceed 10,000.
n_zh: 维基百科称早期估计峰值约2万人，但近期研究认为人口不超过1万。

n: Wikipedia notes the 1238 Khmer-liberation account is older scholarship that later work has questioned.
n_zh: 据维基百科，1238年摆脱高棉统治之说出自早期学说，后来的研究对此提出质疑。

n: Wikipedia's dates (23 September 1215 – 18 February 1294) make Kublai 78 at death, not 79.
n_zh: 据维基百科，忽必烈生卒为1215年9月23日至1294年2月18日，按周岁享年78而非79。

n: Chinese Wikipedia says the book describes more than 200 places visited, not about 100.
n_zh: 据中文维基百科，该书记述亲身经历的二百多个地方，而非近百国。

n: Wikipedia says the cause of his death is disputed: accident or murder ordered by Zhu Yuanzhang.
n_zh: 维基百科称其死因有争议：意外沉船，或为朱元璋派人谋杀。

n: Wikipedia says Kongo was founded c. 1390 through a political marriage between Nima a Nzima and Lukeni lua Nsanze, not simply conquest.
n_zh: 维基百科称刚果王国约1390年由尼马·阿·恩济马与卢凯尼·卢阿·恩桑泽的政治联姻建立，而非单纯征服。

n: Wikipedia says it was first printed in 1522 in an edition bearing a preface dated 1494.
n_zh: 维基百科称1522年首次刊印，该版本所附序文署年为1494年。

n: English Wikipedia says about 100,000 direct deaths; 830,000 is the total drop in registered population including those who fled.
n_zh: 英文维基称直接死亡约10万人，83万为户籍人口总减少数（含迁离者）；中文维基称83万人死亡。

n: Wikipedia (EN) says the rebellion lasted almost eight years, ending in 1629; zh Wikipedia gives 1621-1630.
n_zh: 据英文维基百科，叛乱持续近八年，1629年平定；中文维基百科则记为1621至1630年。

n: English Wikipedia says 100,000 Ming troops were crushed; Chinese Wikipedia gives 130,000 Ming troops.
n_zh: 英文维基百科称明军十万被击溃；中文维基百科记明军共十三万。

n: English Wikipedia says the massacre itself lasted six days; the "ten days" comes from the traditional name and a diary account.
n_zh: 英文维基百科称屠杀本身持续六天；“十日”来自传统称谓与《扬州十日记》。

n: Chinese Wikipedia lists the four customs houses at Guangdong (Macau/Guangzhou), Zhangzhou, Ningbo and Yuntai Mountain, not Xiamen and Shanghai.
n_zh: 中文维基百科记四海关设于粤东（澳门/广州）、漳州府、宁波府和云台山，而非厦门、上海。

n: English Wikipedia says the Dzungars repulsed Qing attacks on one flank and withdrew in good order; Fuquan reported it as a victory.
n_zh: 英文维基百科称准噶尔军击退清军一翼进攻并有序撤退，福全则上报为胜利。

n: Wikipedia (zh intro) says the treaty fixed the eastern section of the Mongolia-Russia border, not the middle section.
n_zh: 维基百科导言称条约划定的是蒙俄边界东段，而非中段。

n: Wikipedia en says the coalition resisted for 17 years (1831-1847); zh Wikipedia gives 1832-1847.
n_zh: 维基百科英文版称抵抗持续17年（1831-1847年），中文版则为1832年至1847年。

n: Wikipedia en calls it the second of the later-termed unequal treaties, after the rejected 1841 Convention of Chuenpi; zh calls it the first signed after defeat.
n_zh: 英文维基称其为继被拒绝的1841年《穿鼻草约》之后的第二个不平等条约；中文维基称其为清朝战败后签订的首个条约。

summary: France joined Cochinchina, Annam, Tonkin and Cambodia into the Indochinese Union; Laos was added in 1899.
summary_zh: 法国将交趾支那、安南、东京和柬埔寨合组为印度支那联邦，1899年又并入老挝。
n: Laos joined in 1899, not 1893, per Wikipedia.
n_zh: 据维基百科，老挝于1899年而非1893年并入。

summary: Christian, Muslim and Palestinian militias, with Syria and Israel involved, fought a war that killed about 120,000 people.
summary_zh: 基督教、穆斯林和巴勒斯坦各派武装混战，叙利亚和以色列卷入其中，约12万人死亡。
n: Wikipedia estimates about 120,000 deaths, not 150,000.
n_zh: 据维基百科，死亡人数估计约为12万而非15万。

n: Wikipedia says most scholarly estimates are 500,000-662,000 Tutsi dead; Rwanda's constitution says over 1 million.
n_zh: 维基百科称多数学者估计图西族死亡人数为50万至66.2万，卢旺达宪法则称超过100万。
